version_conflict: task was modified by someone else
version_invalid: If-Match header is not a valid version
import_empty: the uploaded file has no rows
import_too_many_rows: the file has more rows than the import limit allows
import_too_large: the file is larger than the import limit allows
import_unknown_column: the file has columns this import does not recognize
import_missing_column: the file is missing a required column
import_rows_invalid: no rows were imported because some are invalid
export_too_many_rows: the filter matches more rows than the export limit allows; narrow it
file_unreadable: the uploaded file could not be read
